blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Hybrid attention models combine full and linear attention to achieve a better quality--efficiency trade-off. Converting pretrained Transformers into such models requires identifying which layers should retain full attention under a prescribed budget. We identify two off-policy mismatches in FlashMorph's layer selection: (i) continuous branch interpolation and teacher-forced hidden states differ from discrete hybrid computation; and (ii) frozen model weights fail to account for parameter adaptation during subsequent recovery. We introduce FlashMorph2, an on-policy layer-selection method that (I) evaluates sampled discrete hybrid architectures end to end using their own hidden states, and (II) jointly optimizes layer-selection scores and model weights under the recovery objective to reflect post-adaptation performance. Experiments across Qwen3 model scales and linear-attention variants show that FlashMorph2 consistently outperforms existing layer-selection methods, improving average scores over FlashMorph by $+2.42$ points on RULER, $+1.08$ on LongBench, and $+0.76$ on recall-intensive tasks, while completing layer selection in only $0.72$--$3.57$ GPU hours across 0.6B--8B models, demonstrating high efficiency and scalability.
blocks.zh: 混合关注模式将全关注和线性关注结合起来,实现更好的质量效率权衡. 将事先经过训练的变换器转换成这种模型,需要确定哪些层应在规定的预算中保持充分的注意。 我们在FlashMorph的层层选择中发现了两个不政策错配现象:(一) 持续的分支插值和教师强制隐藏状态与离散混合计算不同;(二) 冻结模型加权数在后续恢复过程中未能计入参数调整。 我们引入了FlashMorph2,一种政策层选择方法,该方法(一)评价抽样的离散混合结构最终使用自己的隐藏状态结束,(二)在恢复目标下共同优化层选择分数和模型权重,以反映适应后的表现. 跨Qwen3模型尺度和线意向变体的实验显示,FlashMorph2持续超越了现有的层选方法,比FlashMorph的平均分数在RULR上提高了2.42美元,在LongBench上提高了1.08美元,在召回密集型任务上提高了0.76美元,同时在0.6B-8B模型上只完成了0.72美元-3.57美元GPU小时的层选,显示出高效率和可扩展性.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Hybrid attention models retain full attention in only a few layers and use linear attention elsewhere, preserving long-context modeling capabilities and precise retrieval ( Arora et al., 2024a ; Jelassi et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026a ) , while substantially reducing computation and KV-cache memory usage ( Katharopoulos et al., 2020 ; Sun et al., 2025b ; Sun et al., 2025a ) . Owing to this favorable trade-off between performance and efficiency, hybrid attention has been adopted in a growing number of production-scale large language models (LLMs) ( Li et al., 2025 ; Team et al., 2025 ; Cao et al., 2026 ; Team, 2026 ; Team et al., 2026 ) . To avoid the prohibitive cost of pretraining from scratch, existing approaches reuse the weights of pretrained LLMs and replace a subset of full attention layers with linear attention, achieving Transformers-to-hybrid conversion. Model quality is then recovered through distillation and continued training ( Kasai et al., 2021 ; Bick et al., 2024 ; Lan et al., 2025 ; Goldstein et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Bick et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . A central challenge in this conversion process is determining which full attention layers to retain under a given budget. As the only layers in the resulting hybrid model that can directly access the entire context, their placement largely determines how much of the original model’s capability can be recovered ( Li et al., 2026a ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Lan et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 混合注意力模型仅保留几层的充分注意力,并在其他地方使用线性注意力,保留长文本模型能力和精确检索(Arora等人,2024a;Jelassi等人,2024;Li等人,2026a),同时大大减少计算和KV-cache内存使用(Katharopoulos等人,2020年;Sun等人,2025b;Sun等人,2025a)。 由于性能和效率之间的这种有利的权衡,越来越多的生产规模大语言模型(LLMs)采用了混合关注(Li等人,2025年;Team等人,2025年;Cao等人,2026年;Team,2026年;Team等人,2026年). 为了避免从零开始进行预训的高昂费用,现有方法重新利用预训LLMS的重量,用线性注意力取代全注意力层的子集,实现变形器到hybrid转换. 然后通过蒸馏和继续培训恢复模型质量(Kasai等人,2021年;Bick等人,2024年;Lan等人,2025年;Goldstein等人,2025年;Wang等人,2024年;Bick等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2025年)。 这一转换过程中的一个中心挑战是确定在特定预算下保留哪些充分关注层。 作为所形成的混合模型中唯一能够直接访问整个上下文的层,它们的放置在很大程度上决定了原始模型的能力可以回收多少(Li等人,2026a; Chen等人,2026年;Lan等人,2026年).

blocks.en: Exhaustively evaluating all possible layer combinations is prohibitively expensive, motivating existing work to explore a variety of layer-selection strategies. Beyond fixed uniform interleaving patterns, PostNAS ( Gu et al., 2026 ) performs supernet-based architecture search, KL-LS ( Li et al., 2026a ) ranks layers by the KL reduction from per-layer restoration and distillation, and HALO ( Chen et al., 2026 ) uses replacement-based sensitivity scoring. More recently, FlashMorph ( Lan et al., 2026 ) jointly optimizes layer-wise gates to learn a global hybrid configuration. Each layer interpolates between aligned full- and linear-attention branches through a continuous gate, which is then discretized under a given full-attention budget. FlashMorph preserves strong long-context recall and general benchmark performance while substantially reducing layer-selection cost.
blocks.zh: 详尽评估所有可能的层层组合费用高昂,促使现有工作探索各种层层选择战略。 除了固定的统一互离模式外,PostNAS(Gu等人,2026年)还进行了超网式架构搜索,KL-LS(Li等人,2026年a)通过每层恢复和蒸馏的KL还原来排序层,HALO(Chen等人,2026年)使用替换式的敏感性评分. 最近,FlashMorph(Lan et al., 2026年)联合优化了分层的门,以学习全球混合构型. 每层通过一个连续的闸门在对齐的全注和线注的分支之间插座,然后在给定的全注预算下进行盘点. FlashMorph保留了很强的长文字回溯和一般基准性能,同时大幅降低了层选择成本.

blocks.en: Limitations. FlashMorph’s layer-selection process still suffers from two forms of off-policy mismatch. (L1) Off-policy computation : The forward computation used during layer selection differs from that of the candidate discrete model. Continuous mixing allows the full- and linear-attention branches to complement each other, while each layer operates on teacher-forced hidden states. At deployment, only one branch is retained per layer and hidden states are generated by the hybrid model itself. Consequently, complementarities observed under continuous mixing may not transfer to the final discrete architecture, and the resulting layer-importance estimates may fail to capture error accumulation and cross-layer compensation. (L2) Off-policy weights : The weights used for layer selection are inherited from the original model and remain frozen during gate optimization, without adapting to the hybrid architecture induced by the selection policy. Layer selection therefore cannot account for the cross-layer co-adaptation of model weights during subsequent recovery, which may alter the layer-importance ranking observed before recovery.
blocks.zh: 限制。 FlashMorph的层层选择过程仍然有两种政策外的不匹配。 (L1) 政策外计算: 层层选择中使用的远期计算不同于候选离散模型. 持续的混合可以使全和线性关注的分支相互补充,而每层则在教师强制的隐藏状态下运行. 在部署时,每层只保留一个分支,隐藏状态由混合模型本身产生. 因此,在持续混合下观察到的互补性可能不会转移到最后的离散结构中,由此产生的层重要性估计数可能无法反映误差累积和跨层补偿。 (L2) 政策外加权: 用于层层选择的权重是从原始模型中继承下来的,并在闸门优化期间保持冷冻,而不适应选择政策诱导的混合结构. 因此,层选择不能说明模型重量在后续恢复期间的跨层共适应,这可能改变在恢复前观察到的层重要性排名。

blocks.en: Our Method. We introduce FlashMorph2 , which improves upon FlashMorph by bringing the on-policy principle into its layer-selection process. To address (L1) , FlashMorph2 samples a discrete hybrid attention architecture that satisfies the prescribed full-attention budget and performs an end-to-end forward pass through the sampled architecture, allowing each layer to operate on hidden states produced by the model itself. To address (L2) , FlashMorph2 jointly trains model weights across these sampled hybrid attention architectures using the same optimization objective as in subsequent recovery training, allowing layer selection to account for performance after weight adaptation.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法。 我们引入FlashMorph2,它通过将政策原则引入其分层选择过程来改进FlashMorph. 为了解决(L1),FlashMorph2对一个符合规定的全注预算的离散混合关注架构进行样本,并进行端对端前传,通过样本架构,允许每个层在模型本身产生的隐藏状态上运行. 为了解决(L2),FlashMorph2利用与之后的恢复训练相同的优化目标,在这些抽样混合关注架构上联合训练模型权重,允许层选择在重量适应后进行性能核算.

blocks.en: Results. Across Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B backbones and three linear-attention variants, FlashMorph2 consistently outperforms all layer-selection baselines, improving average scores over FlashMorph by + 2.42 +2.42 points on RULER, + 1.08 +1.08 on LongBench, and + 0.76 +0.76 on recall-intensive tasks while preserving language modeling and commonsense reasoning capabilities. Moreover, FlashMorph2 completes layer selection in only 0.72 0.72 – 3.57 3.57 GPU hours across 0.6B–8B models, running 8.4 8.4 – 20.8 × 20.8\times faster than HALO and 560 560 – 854 × 854\times faster than KL-LS.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Layer Selection for Transformer-to-hybrid Conversion. Transformer-to-hybrid conversion requires selecting which full-attention layers to retain under a prescribed budget. A simple solution is fixed uniform interleaving ( Lan et al., 2025 ; Goldstein et al., 2025 ) , but it ignores layer-wise heterogeneity in pretrained models. PostNAS ( Gu et al., 2026 ) trains a once-for-all supernet and uses task-guided beam search to determine full-attention layer placement, incurring substantial training and search costs; KL-LS ( Li et al., 2026a ) ranks layers by post-distillation KL loss after single-layer restoration; and HALO ( Chen et al., 2026 ) ranks full-attention layers by the downstream performance changes induced by their individual replacement with linear-attention layers. These layerwise scoring methods incur substantial selection overhead from repeated single-layer evaluations and fail to account for interactions among layers in the resulting hybrid architecture. FlashMorph ( Lan et al., 2026 ) jointly optimizes layerwise gate values, yielding more effective hybrid configurations at substantially lower selection cost. However, these methods remain off-policy due to mismatches in forward computation or model weights between the selection-time and recovered hybrid models. FlashMorph2 improves upon FlashMorph with on-policy layer selection that performs end-to-end forward passes through sampled discrete hybrid architectures while accounting for the effects of weight adaptation during recovery.
blocks.zh: 变形器到hybrid转换的图层选择 。 变形器到变形器的转换需要在规定的预算中选择保留哪一个全心全意层。 一个简单的解决方案是固定的统一互离(Lan等人,2025年;Goldstein等人,2025年),但在预训模型中忽略了层次异性. PostNAS (Gu等人, 2026年) 列车一次全超网,并使用任务制导光束搜索来确定全心全意层布置,引起大量培训和搜索费用; KL-LS (Li等人, 2026a年) 单层恢复后,通过蒸馏后KL损失分层排位; HALO(Chen等人,2026年)则通过个人用线性注意层取代引起的下游性能变化,将全层排位. 这些分层评分方法从反复进行的单层评价中产生大量的间接选择,未能考虑到由此产生的混合结构中各层之间的相互作用。 FlashMorph(Lan等人,2026年)联合优化了层层门值,以大幅降低选择成本的方式产生了更有效的混合配置. 然而,由于预选时间和回收混合模型之间的前置计算或模型权重不匹配,这些方法仍然处于政策外. FlashMorph2改进了FlashMorph,通过政策层选择来进行端到端的前进,通过抽样的离散混合结构,同时考虑恢复期间重量适应的效果.

blocks.en: On-Policy Learning. Teacher forcing relies on ground-truth prefixes and is therefore off-policy with respect to the model’s own generation policy; the resulting train-inference distribution mismatch can lead to exposure bias and error accumulation ( Bengio et al., 2015 ) . To mitigate this distribution shift, on-policy learning emphasizes obtaining supervision on states induced by the learner’s own policy ( Ross et al., 2011 ; Lin et al., 2020 ) . Following this principle, on-policy distillation (OPD) trains students under teacher supervision on sequences generated by the students themselves ( Lu and Lab, 2025 ; Li et al., 2026b ; Ma et al., 2026 ) . FlashMorph2 extends this idea to layer selection by sampling discrete hybrid architectures and estimating layer importance using self-generated hidden states and weights adapted under the recovery objective.
blocks.zh: 政策学习。 教师的强迫依赖于地面真实前缀,因此在模型本身的生成政策上不具有政策性;由此产生的列车推导分配不匹配会导致曝光偏差和错误积累(Bengio等人,2015年)。 为了缓解这一分配转变,政策学习强调对学习者自身政策所引发的状态进行监督(Ross等人,2011年;Lin等人,2020年)。 遵循这一原则,政策蒸馏(OPD)就学生自己产生的序列在教师监督下对学生进行培训(Lu and Lab,2025;Li等人,2026b;Ma等人,2026)。 闪光 摩尔ph2将这一想法延伸至通过取样离散杂交结构进行层层选择,并利用回收目标下调整的自生成隐藏状态和权重来估计层层重要性.

blocks.en: FlashMorph ( Lan et al., 2026 ) builds on the staged distillation pipeline of RADLADS ( Goldstein et al., 2025 ) and HALO ( Chen et al., 2026 ) for Transformer-to-hybrid conversion. Treating weight transfer as initialization, we organize the subsequent pipeline into four stages: layerwise alignment (Stage 1), layer selection (Stage 2), logits distillation (Stage 3), and long-context finetuning (Stage 4).

blocks.en: 3.2 Rethinking FlashMorph
blocks.zh: 3.2 重新思考闪光镜

blocks.en: Layer selection objective. FlashMorph formulates layer selection as a subset selection problem that maximizes hybrid model performance under a fixed full-attention budget ( Lan et al., 2026 ) . Since the quality of a selected layers also depends on subsequent recovery training, we evaluate selected architectures based on their post-recovery performance: ℐ ⋆ = arg ⁡ max ℐ ∈ 𝒞 K ​ Score ⁡ ( ℳ ⁡ ( ℐ , θ ⋆ ) ) , \displaystyle\mathcal{I}^{\star}=\arg\max_{\mathcal{I}\in\mathcal{C}_{K}}\ \operatorname{Score}\big(\mathcal{M}(\mathcal{I};\theta^{\star})\big), (9) where θ ⋆ \theta^{\star} denotes the model parameters of the selected hybrid architecture ℐ \mathcal{I} obtained after initialization from θ 0 \theta_{0} and subsequent recovery training, and Score ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \mathrm{Score}(\cdot) measures post-recovery task performance. Individually recovering and evaluating all ( L K ) \binom{L}{K} hybrid architectures is prohibitively expensive. FlashMorph therefore uses Eq. 6 as a proxy for layer selection before recovery. However, this proxy has two off-policy limitations that prevent it from fully reflecting the post-recovery performance of the resulting hybrid model:

L1: Off-policy computation . During FlashMorph’s layer selection, continuous gates mix full- and linear-attention outputs computed from teacher hidden states (Eqs. 5 and 6 ). The deployed model instead uses a discrete hybrid architecture under the prescribed full-attention budget, retaining one branch per layer and propagating its own hidden states (Eq. 3 ). Thus, rankings learned under continuous mixing can misrepresent layer importance in the discrete hybrid architecture, while teacher-forced layerwise evaluation fails to capture how hidden-state deviations induced by attention replacement propagate through subsequent hybrid layers.
blocks.zh: L1:非政策性计算。 在FlashMorph的图层选择过程中,连续的门会将从教师隐藏状态(Eqs. 5和6)计算的全和线性注意输出混合在一起。 所部署的模型而是在规定的全程预算下使用一个离散的混合结构,每层保留一个分支,并宣传自己的隐藏状态(Eq. 3 . 因此,在连续混合下获得的排名可以错报离散混合结构中的层层重要性,而师资强制的层层评价则无法捕捉到因注意力取代而引发的隐藏状态偏差如何通过后续的混合层传播.

blocks.en: L2: Off-policy weights . Eq. 6 performs layer selection by optimizing continuous gates while keeping model weights frozen at their pre-recovery values θ 0 \theta_{0} , whereas Eq. 9 evaluates discrete hybrid architectures using the recovered parameters θ ⋆ \theta^{\star} . Since the frozen weights have not been adapted to the candidate hybrid architectures, subsequent recovery may alter the layer-importance ranking, potentially rendering the initial selection suboptimal.
blocks.zh: L2:非政策权重. Eq. 6通过优化连续门来进行层层选择,同时将模型重量冻结在回收前的数值 ^ 0\theta_{0},而Eq. 9 则利用回收参数 ^\theta^{\star}来评价离散混合结构。 由于冰冻的重量尚未适应候选混合结构,随后的恢复可能会改变层重要性的排名,有可能使初始选择不尽人意.

blocks.en: These two forms of off-policy limitation highlight the need for layer selection to jointly account for end-to-end forward computation and weight adaptation on discrete hybrid architectures satisfying the prescribed full-attention budget. Building on this insight, Sec. 4 introduces our proposed FlashMorph2’s on-policy layer-selection method.
blocks.zh: 这两种形式的政策外限制突出了层层选择的必要性,以便联合核算满足规定的全程预算的离散混合结构的端到端前计算和权重调整。 基于这一见解,第4节介绍了我们提议的FlashMorph2政策层选择方法。

blocks.en: Drawing on on-policy learning, FlashMorph2 refines FlashMorph’s optimization-based layer selection. Specifically, as illustrated in Fig. 2 , FlashMorph2 samples discrete hybrid configurations satisfying the prescribed full-attention budget, performs end-to-end forward computation with self-propagated hidden states rather than teacher-forced hidden states, and jointly optimizes the layer-selection parameters and model weights using the same training objective as in the subsequent recovery stage to guide the layer selection.

To account for weight adaptation during subsequent recovery, we initialize the student model with the layerwise aligned parameters θ 0 \theta_{0} and jointly optimize the layer-selection parameters ϕ \boldsymbol{\phi} and model weights θ \theta over sampled hybrid architectures: min ϕ , θ ⁡ 𝒥 ⁡ ( ϕ , θ ) = 𝔼 ℐ ∼ q ϕ ​ [ ℒ KD ​ ( θ , ℐ ) ] , \displaystyle\min_{\boldsymbol{\phi},\,\theta}\ \mathcal{J}(\boldsymbol{\phi},\theta)=\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{I}\sim q_{\boldsymbol{\phi}}}\Big[\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{KD}}(\theta;\mathcal{I})\Big], (11) where ℒ KD ​ ( θ , ℐ ) \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{KD}}(\theta;\mathcal{I}) denotes the logits distillation objective used in subsequent recovery training stage (Eq. 7 ), computed on the currently sampled hybrid architecture ℐ \mathcal{I} .
All sampled hybrid architectures are constructed by selecting attention branches from a shared morphable model, directly reusing the parameters of the selected branches. During layer-selection optimization, we compute the distillation loss on sampled architectures and obtain gradients for both the layer-selection parameters ϕ \boldsymbol{\phi} and model weights θ \theta through a single backward pass. The layer-selection parameters are updated via gradient straight-through estimator (STE) ( Bengio et al., 2013 ; Jang et al., 2016 ) (Sec. 4.3 ) to adjust the architecture-sampling distribution. For each sampled architecture, unselected attention branches receive no gradients. As the model weights continuously adapt to the sampled hybrid architectures, the layer-selection parameters are updated based on the corresponding optimization signals. This on-policy layer-selection method incorporates weight adaptation into architecture evaluation, mitigating the discrepancy between frozen-weight layer evaluation and post-recovery performance.

blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Experiment Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Model and training. We use Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B ( Yang et al., 2025a ) as pretrained Transformer backbones and construct hybrid models with three linear-attention variants: Lightning Attention ( Qin et al., 2024 ) , Gated Linear Attention (GLA) ( Yang et al., 2023 ) , and Gated DeltaNet (GDN) ( Yang et al., 2025b ) . We implement the linear-attention branches using the flash-linear-attention library ( Yang and Zhang, 2024 ) , incorporating QK normalization, GQA-to-MHA conversion, output normalization, and an output gate. Both full- and linear-attention layers adopt RoPE ( Su et al., 2024 ) . Unless otherwise specified, the hybrid ratio of linear-attention to full-attention layers is 3:1. We follow the four-stage Transformer-to-hybrid conversion pipeline described in Sec. 3.1 , using training data randomly sampled from DCLM ( Li et al., 2024 ) . Details on model and training configurations are in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 模范与训练. 我们使用Qune3-0.6B和Qune3-1.7B(Yang等人,2025a)作为预先训练的变形器骨干,并构造混合模型,具有三个线性意向变体: 闪电关注(秦 al等人,2024年),Gated Linear 关注(GLA)(杨 al等人,2023年),Gated DeltaNet(GDN)(杨 et等人,2025年b). 我们使用闪光线性关注库(杨和张,2024年)实施线性关注分支,包含QK正常化,GQA对MHA转换,输出正常化,以及输出门. 全注层和线注层均采用RoPE(Su等人,2024年)。 除非另有说明,线性留念层与全留念层的混合比为3:1. 使用从DCLM(Li等人,2024年)随机抽取的培训数据, 关于模型和培训配置的详细情况见附录A。

blocks.en: Evaluation. We evaluate FlashMorph2 on long-context capabilities using RULER ( Hsieh et al., 2024 ) and 14 tasks from LongBench ( Bai et al., 2024 ) . We further evaluate performance on 6 recall-intensive tasks using the prefix-linear-attention evaluation suite ( Arora et al., 2024b ) . We also evaluate language modeling perplexity and zero-shot commonsense reasoning using lm-evaluation-harness ( Gao et al., 2024 ) . All evaluations are conducted using vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) for accelerated inference. Detailed evaluation settings are also provided in the Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 评价。 我们利用RULAR(Hsieh等人,2024年)和Long Bench(Bai等人,2024年)的14项任务评估FlashMorph2的长文本能力。 我们利用前缀线性关注评价套件(Arora等人,2024年b),进一步评价6项召回密集型任务的执行情况。 我们还利用lm-valuation-harness(Gao等人,2024年)来评价语言模型的复杂性和零镜头常识推理。 所有评价都使用VLLM(Kwon等人,2023年)进行,以加快推论。 附录B也提供了详细的评价设置。

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare FlashMorph2 against five layer selection baselines, including: uniform interleaving (Uniform), PostNAS ( Gu et al., 2026 ) , KL-LS ( Li et al., 2026a ) , HALO ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , and FlashMorph ( Lan et al., 2026 ) . To isolate the effect of layer selection, all methods use the same full-attention budget, layerwise-aligned initialization, and subsequent recovery training settings.
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们比较FlashMorph2与5层选择基线,包括: 统一的对接(Uniform),PostNAS(Gu等人,2026),KL-LS(Li等人,2026a),HALO(Chen等人,2026),FlashMorph(Lan等人,2026). 为了隔离层选择的效果,所有方法都使用相同的全心全意预算,分层对齐初始化,以及后续的恢复培训设置.

blocks.en: 5.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Long-context capabilities. Table 1 reports long-context performance under the same full-attention budget. FlashMorph2 achieves the highest average scores on both RULER and LongBench across all six combinations of backbone size and linear-attention variant. Averaged across these configurations, it raises the RULER score from 63.26 to 65.68 ( + 2.42 +2.42 points) and the LongBench score from 29.86 to 30.94 ( + 1.08 +1.08 points) compared with FlashMorph. These results demonstrate that FlashMorph2 identifies hybrid architectures with consistently superior long-context performance following an identical recovery training settings.
blocks.zh: 长结能力. 表1报告了同一全额拨款预算下的长期执行情况。 闪光 Morph2在主干大小和线性注意变体的所有6种组合中,都实现了RAULR和LongBench的平均分数最高. 在整个配置中,与FlashMorph相比,平均将RULAR的得分从63.26提高到65.68(+2.42+2.42分),将LongBench的得分从29.86提高到30.94(+1.08+1.08分). 这些结果显示,FlashMorph2在相同的恢复培训设置之后,识别出具有一贯优异长文本性能的混合结构.

blocks.en: Recall-intensive tasks. Table 2 reports performance on six recall-intensive tasks. FlashMorph2 achieves the highest average score across tasks in all six combinations of backbone size and linear-attention variant. Averaged across these configurations, it improves the score from 48.94 to 49.70 ( + 0.76 +0.76 points) compared with FlashMorph. These results indicate that the benefits of FlashMorph2 extend to real-world in-context retrieval tasks.
blocks.zh: 召回密集型任务. 表2报告六项召回密集型任务的执行情况。 闪光 Morph2在骨干大小和线意向变体的所有六个组合中,实现了跨任务平均得分最高. 平均在这些配置上,与FlashMorph相比,它的得分从48.94提高到49.70(+0.76+0.76分). 这些结果表明,FlashMorph2的好处延伸到现实世界的内文本检索任务.

FlashMorph2 remains competitive with the layer-selection baselines on these evaluations, suggesting that general language capabilities are preserved alongside the improvements in long-context and recall-intensive tasks.

blocks.zh: 5.3 分析

blocks.en: Layer-selection efficiency. Fig. 4 reports the computational cost of layer selection across different model scales. Compared with FlashMorph, FlashMorph2 requires 1.7 1.7 – 2.6 × 2.6\times the FLOPs and 1.9 1.9 – 2.4 × 2.4\times the GPU hours, reflecting the additional computation required for end-to-end evaluation of discrete hybrid architectures and concurrent model adaptation. This overhead is confined to a one-time selection stage, which accounts for approximately only < 1 % <1\% of the overall conversion token budget, and does not affect deployment efficiency under the same full-attention budget. Across models ranging from 0.6B to 8B parameters, FlashMorph2 completes layer selection in only 0.72 0.72 – 3.57 3.57 GPU hours. It is also substantially more efficient than layerwise-scoring approaches. Relative to FlashMorph2, HALO requires 1.3 1.3 – 2.2 × 2.2\times as many FLOPs and 8.4 8.4 – 20.8 × 20.8\times as many GPU hours, while KL-LS requires 575 575 – 897 × 897\times and 560 560 – 854 × 854\times as many, respectively. Overall, despite its modest overhead over FlashMorph, FlashMorph2 remains highly efficient and scalable while being substantially more efficient than alternative layer-selection methods.

blocks.en: Hybrid ratios. Fig. 4 reports RULER performance on Qwen3-1.7B across different hybrid ratios for GLA and GDN. While full linearization ( 1 : 0 1{:}0 ) reduces the RULER score from 87.66 to 9.57 on GLA and 21.89 on GDN, retaining a small subset of full-attention layers substantially restores retrieval performance. Across all evaluated hybrid ratios ( 6 : 1 6{:}1 , 3 : 1 3{:}1 , and 1 : 1 1{:}1 ), FlashMorph2 consistently outperforms all baselines on both linear-attention variants. The advantage of optimization-based layer selection is particularly pronounced under the tightest full-attention budget ( 6 : 1 6{:}1 ), where FlashMorph2 achieves 60.12 on GLA and 64.45 on GDN, outperforming Uniform by + 10.65 +10.65 and + 7.86 +7.86 points while several competing methods fall below simple uniform interleaving. As the full-attention ratio increases to 3 : 1 3{:}1 and 1 : 1 1{:}1 , performance across methods gradually converges toward the full-attention backbone, yet FlashMorph2 continues to improve upon FlashMorph in all settings, reaching 76.93 on GLA ( + 1.42 +1.42 ) and 80.69 on GDN ( + 0.92 +0.92 ) at 1 : 1 1{:}1 . Overall, these results confirm that FlashMorph2 remains effective and robust across varying hybrid ratios.

blocks.en: Ablation study. Table 3 evaluates the effects of on-policy computation and on-policy weight adaptation on Qwen3-1.7B with GDN. Removing on-policy computation significantly reduces scores by 29.55 29.55 points on RULER and 5.71 5.71 points on LongBench. Inspecting the selected architectures reveals that this variant allocates all seven full-attention layers to the deepest layers { 20 , 21 , 23 , 24 , 25 , 26 , 27 } \{20,21,23,24,25,26,27\} , leaving the first 20 layers entirely linear. This concentration reflects the mismatch between teacher-forced local scoring and end-to-end discrete hybrid computation, where early hidden-state deviations accumulate across layers. Removing on-policy weight adaptation instead lowers RULER by 4.88 4.88 points and LongBench by 1.38 1.38 points, replacing layers { 6 , 17 , 19 , 20 } \{6,17,19,20\} selected by FlashMorph2 with { 0 , 1 , 2 , 26 } \{0,1,2,26\} , which indicates that weight adaptation substantially alters the preferred budget allocation. Removing both components reverts to FlashMorph, which still trails FlashMorph2 by 1.39 1.39 points on RULER and 1.19 1.19 points on LongBench. Overall, these results confirm that discrete hybrid computation and weight adaptation are complementary and must be jointly considered during layer selection.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we present FlashMorph2, an on-policy layer-selection method for converting pretrained Transformers into hybrid attention models under a prescribed full-attention budget. To overcome the off-policy computation and weight mismatches in prior optimization-based selection, FlashMorph2 samples discrete budget-constrained hybrid architectures, performs end-to-end forward passes with self-propagated hidden states, and jointly optimizes layer-selection scores and model weights under the recovery training objective. Experiments across multiple Qwen3 model scales, linear-attention variants, and hybrid ratios show that FlashMorph2 consistently improves long-context and recall-intensive performance over existing baselines while maintaining high selection efficiency and scalability.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们提出了FlashMorph2,一种政策层选择方法,在规定的全注预算下,将预先训练的变形器转换成混合关注模型. 为了克服之前基于优化的选题中政策外的计算和权重不匹配,FlashMorph2对离散的预算约束混合结构进行了样本,以自我传播的隐藏状态进行端对端前传,并在恢复培训目标下共同优化层选分和模型权重. 跨越多个Qwen3模型尺度,线性意向变体,以及混合比的实验显示,FlashMorph2在保持高选择效率和可伸缩性的同时,比现有基线持续改善长写和回溯密集性能.

blocks.en: Table 4 summarizes the model architectural specifications of the Qwen3 backbones ( Yang et al., 2025a ) and their corresponding hybrid attention models under the default 3 : 1 3{:}1 linear-to-full attention hybrid ratio. To convert grouped-query attention (GQA) in the pretrained full-attention layers into multi-head linear attention (MHA), we expand the pretrained key and value projection weights by repeating each KV head across its corresponding query group during initialization, while directly reusing the pretrained query and output projection weights. Each linear-attention branch is further equipped with RMSNorm on queries, keys, and branch outputs, an element-wise sigmoid output gate initialized to zero, and rotary position embeddings (RoPE) ( Su et al., 2024 ) . All newly introduced parameters in the linear-attention branches (e.g., decay/forget gates and output gates) are trained from scratch starting in Stage 1.

blocks.en: Table 5 summarizes the training hyperparameters across all four stages of the Transformer-to-hybrid conversion pipeline: layerwise alignment (Stage 1), on-policy layer selection (Stage 2), logits distillation (Stage 3), and long-context finetuning (Stage 4). All stages are trained on randomly sampled subsets of DCLM ( Li et al., 2024 ) using the Adam optimizer ( Kingma and Ba, 2014 ) without weight decay. In Stage 1, only the linear-attention branches are updated while all pretrained backbone weights remain frozen. In Stage 2, we initialize all layer-selection scores ϕ \boldsymbol{\phi} to 0.5 0.5 and jointly optimize ϕ \boldsymbol{\phi} and the model weights θ \theta under a Warmup–Stable–Decay (WSD) ( Hu et al., 2024 ) learning rate schedule. After Stage 2, we retain the top- K K full-attention layers, reinitialize the selected hybrid attention model with the Stage 1 weights θ 0 \theta_{0} , and train all model parameters end to end during Stage 3 and Stage 4. To ensure a fair comparison, all layer-selection methods share the same Stage 1 checkpoint and identical Stage 3–4 recovery training settings.

blocks.en: Long-context Capabilities. We evaluate long-context retrieval and understanding on RULER ( Hsieh et al., 2024 ) and LongBench ( Bai et al., 2024 ) . For RULER, we evaluate across all 13 tasks grouped into four categories: Needle-in-a-Haystack (NIAH), including Single-NIAH (SG1–SG3), Multi-keys NIAH (MK1–MK3), Multi-queries NIAH (MQ), and Multi-values NIAH (MV); Variable Tracking (VT); Aggregation (Agg.), including Common Words Extraction (CWE) and Frequent Words Extraction (FWE); and Question Answering, including QA1 ( Rajpurkar et al., 2016 ) , and QA2 ( Yang et al., 2018 ) . For LongBench, we evaluate on 14 tasks spanning five categories: Single-Document QA, including NarrativeQA (NQA; Kočiskỳ et al. 2018 ), Qasper (QQA; Dasigi et al. 2021 ), and MultiFieldQA (MFQ; Bai et al. 2024 ); Multi-Document QA, including HotpotQA (HQA; Yang et al. 2018 ), 2WikiMultihopQA (2WM; Ho et al. 2020 ), and MuSiQue (Mus; Trivedi et al. 2022 ); Summarization, including GovReport (GvR; Huang et al. 2021 ), QMSum (QMS; Zhong et al. 2021 ), and MultiNews (MNs; Fabbri et al. 2019 ); Few-shot Learning (Few-shot), including TREC (TRC; Li and Roth 2002 ), TriviaQA (TQA; Joshi et al. 2017 ), and SAMSum (SSM; Gliwa et al. 2019 ); and Code Completion (Code), including Long Code Completion (LCC; Guo et al. 2023 ) and RepoBench-P (RBP; Liu et al. 2024 ).

blocks.en: Recall-intensive Tasks. We evaluate real-world recall-intensive tasks across six datasets: FDA ( Arora et al., 2023 ) for PDF key-value retrieval, SWDE ( Lockard et al., 2019 ) for structured HTML relation extraction, and four question-answering datasets including SQuAD (SQD; Rajpurkar et al. 2018 ), Natural Questions (NQ; Kwiatkowski et al. 2019 ), TriviaQA (TQA; Joshi et al. 2017 ), and DROP ( Dua et al., 2019 ) .
blocks.zh: 召回密集型任务。 我们评价六个数据集中的现实世界召回密集型任务: 林业局 (Arora等人,2023年)用于PDF密钥值检索,SWDE(Lockard等人,2019年)用于结构化的HTML关系提取,以及包括SQuAD(SQD;Rajpurkar等人,2018年),自然问题(NQ;Kwiatkowski等人,2019年),TriviaQA(TQA;Joshi等人,2017年)和DROP(Dua等人,2019年)在内的四个问答数据集.

blocks.en: Language Modeling and Commonsense Reasoning. Following previous work ( Gu and Dao, 2023 ; Yang et al., 2025b ) , we evaluate our method on language modeling perplexity and zero-shot commonsense reasoning benchmarks: WikiText (Wiki.; Merity et al. 2016 ), LAMBDA (LMB.; Paperno et al. 2016 ), ARC-easy (ARC-e) and ARC-challenge (ARC-c) ( Clark et al., 2018 ) , PIQA ( Bisk et al., 2020 ) , HellaSwag (Hella.; Zellers et al. 2019 ), WinoGrande (Wino.; Sakaguchi et al. 2021 ), SIQA ( Sap et al., 2019 ) , and BoolQ ( Clark et al., 2019 ) .
blocks.zh: 语言建模与常识理性. 继先前的工作(Gu and Dao, 2023; Yang et al., 2025b)之后,我们评价了我们的语言模型模拟复杂度和零镜头常识推理基准的方法:Wikitext(Wiki.;Merity et al. 2016),LAMBDA(LMB.; Paperno et al. 2016),ARC-e)和ARC-挑战(ARC-c) (Clark等人,2018年),PIQA(Bisk等人,2020年),HelaSwag(Hella.;Zellers等人,2019年),WinoGrande(Wino.;Sakaguchi等人,2021年),SIQA(Sap等人,2019年),和BoulQ (克拉克等人,2019年).

blocks.en: Tables 7 , 8 , and 9 present the detailed per-task results on RULER, LongBench, and language modeling and zero-shot commonsense reasoning benchmarks, respectively. In addition to the Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B configurations reported in the main text, we further scale our evaluation to larger dense and MoE backbones, including Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-30B-A3B with Lightning Attention. Across these larger model scales, FlashMorph2 continues to consistently outperform competing layer-selection baselines on both RULER and LongBench, while preserving strong language modeling perplexity and zero-shot commonsense reasoning accuracy.
